name: Manic EMU QoL
subtitle: Stripped-down Manic EMU for 3DS, DS and Game Boy
description: A modified Manic EMU with only Azahar (3DS), melonDS DS (DS) and mGBA (GBA, GBC, GB). Built automatically from github.com/duhdawgg/manic-emu-QoL-changes.

apps.name: Manic EMU QoL
apps.subtitle: 3DS, DS and Game Boy emulator
apps.localizedDescription: Manic EMU trimmed to 3DS (Azahar), DS (melonDS DS) and GBA/GBC/GB (mGBA). 3DS resolution (1x-4x) is now saved per game and applied at launch.

versions.localizedDescription: Build 12: first QoL build. Only 3DS, DS, GBA, GBC and GB. GB/GBC run on mGBA. 3DS resolution is remembered per game (1x-4x).
